name: Mihama Inori
source:
Inori is a first-year student and a member of the drama club associated with the school. She’s the only daughter of a wealthy family.

Her health has been poor since she was young.

If Ritsuki hadn't talked to her, she probably would not have made any friends, as she had never thought about doing so before.
